falseSynonyms.zh: 完成不一定等於達成 finish/complete 主要表示把事情做完；achieve 通常包含『成功達到想要的結果』。有些任務做完了，卻未必達成目標。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can complete a project without achieving the intended result.

falseSynonyms.zh: 贏得不等於一般的達成 win 適合比賽、選舉、獎項或競爭；achieve 可用於更廣泛的目標和成果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She won the competition, but achieved her long-term goal through years of training.

falseSynonyms.zh: 賺取／贏得不等於所有 achieve earn 通常表示透過努力獲得金錢、資格、尊重等；只適用於某些受詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can earn respect, but you usually achieve a goal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 產生結果不等於達成目標 produce 表示產生、製造；achieve 強調成功達到預期目標。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A process may produce results without achieving its original objective.

falseSynonyms.zh: 完成程序不等於達到結果 complete 著重把一件事做完；achieve 著重結果成功。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He completed the course and achieved a high final grade.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獲得東西不等於一般的成就 acquire 偏向獲得、習得某物；不適合所有 goal/target/result 語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She acquired new skills and achieved her career goal.
